headline: Copper Rises 1.3 Percent as Bitcoin Holds Near 84k
narrative: Copper printed 6.76, up 1.3 percent, the largest move on the board. Gold at 4,173.9 was off 0.08 percent and silver at 58.95 was off 0.36 percent, so the haven pipes did not follow. Bitcoin held near 84k and was little changed, leaving the session bid in the industrial metal rather than in spot crypto.
author: jordan
